texts: Molecular events in the adventitia may have a role in aneurysm formation: E.
Aneurysms are no longer seen only as a failure of the media: inflammation, matrix-degrading enzymes and signalling in the adventitia and its small vessels also weaken the wall.

Marfan syndrome is caused by deficiency of fibrillin-1, vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome by abnormal type III collagen, and excessive TGF-beta signalling increases, rather than decreases, collagen synthesis and matrix remodelling.
In the picture, the bubble swells where the crews on the orca's outer skin stand idle.
Memory hook: the outer skin's crews help decide where the bubble swells.
